title: Terms and privacy

sections.heading: What we keep
lines: If you sign up for text alerts, we keep four things.
Your phone number.
Your language.
Your neighbourhood: Thorncliffe Park or Flemingdon Park.
Choices you make if you want to, such as your building, your floor and the groups you belong to.
We do not ask for your name. We do not ask for your unit number, your email or a password. We do not keep them.
If you do not sign up, we keep nothing about you. This app sets no cookies. It does not keep the questions you type.

sections.heading: Who handles your information
lines: Four companies help us run the service. They handle information for us.
Twilio sends the text messages. It handles your phone number and our messages to you. Where Twilio does this: TODO(owner).
Cohere translates alerts and helps match questions you type in search. It never gets your phone number. Where Cohere does this: TODO(owner).
Vercel runs the website. Its servers are in Montreal. If there is an outage, it may use servers in the United States.
Supabase keeps the database that holds your number, language, neighbourhood and choices. The database is in Canada.

sections.heading: Who owns the data
lines: The community owns the data. The Hub looks after it for you and your neighbours.

sections.heading: How to stop
lines: Reply STOP to any text from the Hub. Or reply 0, then reply 0 again to confirm.
When you stop, we delete your subscription. That means we delete your phone number and your choices. We cannot get them back.
After that, we send you nothing.

sections.heading: Who can sign up
lines: You must be 16 or older to sign up.
If you are younger than 16, a parent or guardian must help you sign up.

sections.heading: About the messages
lines: Hub staff check every alert before it is sent.
Because of this, a message may not be sent overnight.

sections.heading: Questions and your information
lines: To see what we hold about you, or to fix it, contact our privacy contact.
Hub staff will call your number back to check that it is yours. Then they will tell you what we hold. If something is wrong, they will fix it.
